scripts.docker:build: docker build --no-cache -f Dockerfile --build-arg NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV --build-arg PM2_PUBLIC_KEY=$PM2_PUBLIC_KEY --build-arg PM2_SECRET_KEY=$PM2_SECRET_KEY --build-arg DB_USER=$DB_USER --build-arg DB_PASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD --build-arg DB_HOST=$DB_CONTAINER_NAME --build-arg DB_NAME=$DB_NAME --build-arg DB_DIALECT=$DB_DIALECT --build-arg NODE_PORT_IN=$NODE_PORT_IN -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA .
scripts.docker:build:tag: docker build --no-cache -f Dockerfile --build-arg NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV --build-arg PM2_PUBLIC_KEY=$PM2_PUBLIC_KEY --build-arg PM2_SECRET_KEY=$PM2_SECRET_KEY --build-arg DB_USER=$DB_USER --build-arg DB_PASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD --build-arg DB_HOST=$DB_CONTAINER_NAME --build-arg DB_NAME=$DB_NAME --build-arg DB_DIALECT=$DB_DIALECT --build-arg NODE_PORT_IN=$NODE_PORT_IN -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_TAG_NAME .
scripts.docker:start: TZ='UTC' docker compose -p api-$NODE_ENV -f docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.$NODE_ENV up -d
scripts.docker:start:db: TZ='UTC' docker compose -p api-$NODE_ENV -f docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.$NODE_ENV up node-db -d
scripts.docker:stop: TZ='UTC' docker compose -p api-$NODE_ENV -f docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.$NODE_ENV down
scripts.docker:stop:db: TZ='UTC' docker compose -p api-$NODE_ENV -f docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.$NODE_ENV down node-db
scripts.docker:remove: TZ='UTC' docker compose -p api-$NODE_ENV -f docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.$NODE_ENV down --rmi all || true
scripts.docker:remove:database: TZ='UTC' docker compose -p api-$NODE_ENV -f docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.$NODE_ENV down --rmi all $DB_CONTAINER_NAME || true
scripts.docker:init-db: docker exec -e NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV $NODE_CONTAINER_NAME npm run init-db
scripts.docker:migrate: docker exec -e NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV $NODE_CONTAINER_NAME npm run migrate
scripts.docker:migrate:undo: docker exec -e NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV $NODE_CONTAINER_NAME npm run migrate:undo
scripts.docker:seed: docker exec -e NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV $NODE_CONTAINER_NAME npm run seed
scripts.docker:seed:load-test: docker exec -e NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV $NODE_CONTAINER_NAME npm run seed:load-test
scripts.docker:seed:undo:load-test: docker exec -e NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV $NODE_CONTAINER_NAME npm run seed:undo:load-test
scripts.init-db: npm run db-reset && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.init-db:load-test: npm run init-db && npm run seed:load-test
